description: Typical live bad cases (docs/live_bad_cases.md). Outcomes are verified agent grades from data/evaluation/live_usage_grades.json; the human-readable table is the primary presentation.

cases.root_cause: Each evidence unit was serialized three times with its full citation object; fragmented pages expanded ~10k characters of text to 100-400k, above the 100,000-character budget, so the request was refused before generation.
cases.mitigation: Compact model view (each unit once as [id, page, kind, text]); provenance kept local; over budget drop the lowest-ranked passage that is not a company's or year's last; recheck the gate on packed passages.

cases.root_cause: Sources contain NBSP, PDF ligatures and curly quotes; the model retyped them (spaces, letters, NUL plus hex), so the exact-substring check failed on correct drafts.
cases.mitigation: Citation-repair pre-pass matches under NFKC/whitespace/dot-leader/hyphen normalization and rewrites the quote to the exact source span; the strict validator is unchanged.

cases.root_cause: The parser stores one visual line as adjacent units; the model quotes across the boundary or cites the neighbouring evidence ID.
cases.mitigation: Split a uniquely matching cross-unit quote into exact per-unit citations; rebind wrong IDs only to a unique exact match in the same report; one corrective retry for mechanical failures.

cases.root_cause: One global vector search without entity resolution: aliases ('coke'), ambiguous tickers ('HD') and the more frequent company crowded out the other side.
cases.mitigation: Query-scope resolver (names, aliases, typos, tickers, Chinese names); one exact FAISS search per company restricted to its reports; Top-5 reserves slots per company.

cases.root_cause: Prompt v1 forbade derived values; margins and growth rates could not be quoted.
cases.mitigation: Claims may carry a calculation object over cited operand cells; the application recomputes it in Decimal (scale constants only, sign/direction checked) and renders the formula.

cases.failure_type: Relative period resolved to a stale year
cases.root_cause: No resolution of 'last year' / 'current'; the model chose a year from its own knowledge and the typo 'starbuks' weakened matching.
cases.mitigation: Resolve relative periods to each company's latest report, filter retrieval to it, and pass the interpretation to both models; fuzzy company matching.

cases.failure_type: Undated question answered from an old report
cases.root_cause: No period given and the reranker preferred older tables.
cases.mitigation: Dedicated latest-report pool and two reserved latest-year slots for undated questions, plus a note to answer for and state the latest fiscal year.

cases.failure_type: Historical figure presented as a forecast
cases.root_cause: The generator relabelled FY2025 actuals as a 2027 projection and the verifier approved it while its reason noted the mismatch; no deterministic period check.
cases.mitigation: Deterministic grounding of years, dates, numbers and companies against cited text; forecast intent and out-of-coverage notes; verdicts whose reason expresses doubt are rejected.

cases.root_cause: Without year scoping, FY2024 reports outranked FY2023 ones and the verifier did not compare periods.
cases.mitigation: Explicit years restrict each company's pool to that report; both models receive the requested period.

cases.root_cause: Quotes were exact and numbers grounded, but the claim dropped 'Organic/non-GAAP' or 'including noncontrolling interests', or added 'excluding financing'; the verifier missed the basis change.
cases.mitigation: Per-figure qualifier check: a qualifier attached to a quoted figure must stay with that figure in the claim; 'excluding' and similar narrowing words may only come from the sources.

replay.note: Iteration-2 released drafts replayed through the final checks

cases.failure_type: Partial answer released with an admitted gap
cases.root_cause: The generator answered the convenient part and wrote that the rest was not provided; the verifier passed it; a retry could delete the admission.
cases.mitigation: Claims admitting missing evidence are rejected and that failure is never retried.

cases.failure_type: Over-refusal by the calibrated confidence gate
cases.root_cause: Raw reranker logits are uncalibrated; table rows and scoped pools score low even when the answer is correct.
cases.mitigation: No default threshold; release is decided by exact references, deterministic grounding and the verifier; the 6.359375 gate stays an opt-in diagnostic.

cases.root_cause: Prompt v2's worked examples were written from observed live failures: the scale example used A06's wrong sub-row figure (6,690) and the calculation example was B04's gold answer (Intel -31.4% from 54,228 and 79,024).
cases.mitigation: Prompt v2.1 uses a fictional 'Example Corp'; prompts scanned for any question-pool figure; the final run repeated in full.
